## 🚀 Feature Summary

Describe the solution you would like to see, how users would interact with it, or where in the UI it fits.

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or design tokens references here.
